# Vendored Kconfiglib

- Upstream: https://github.com/ulfalizer/Kconfiglib
- Version: `14.1.0`
- Files: `kconfiglib.py` and upstream `LICENSE.txt`

The vendored single-file library keeps CMake configuration independent of a
machine-wide Python installation. `tools/kconfig/requirements.txt` records the
matching package version for tooling environments that prefer pip.
